summary: Defines inventory sources as the strings passed to inventory plugins (files, scripts, or raw data) and lists example plugins with their source types, such as host list, yaml, constructed, ini, virtualbox and script.
questions: Can I pass a comma-separated list of hosts to -i?
What kind of source does the constructed inventory plugin take?

answer_card.title: Inventory sources
answer_card.answer_md:
An inventory source is the input string a plugin consumes via `-i`: a file path, script path, or raw data.
- host list: comma-separated hosts
- yaml / ini: path to data file
- constructed, virtualbox: path to YAML config file
- script: path to an executable that outputs JSON
